verdict.rationale: Secureframe explicitly documents a hosted, customizable Trust Center where prospects can view live control status, request/self-serve certifications and reports, and admins can enforce NDA gating before granting access — directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration (e.g., customer case study or review) confirming this closes security reviews in practice, and no explicit mention of 'live control status' display terminology beyond general trust center features.
